cli.intro: OpenPPT — create, inspect and play editable presentation decks on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a native deck and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a project file and print its committed revision and slides
cmd.import: Import a PresentationML package as an editable project
cmd.inspect: Run geometry and rule checks on a project file
cmd.play: Walk the static show of a project file, or play a PPTX package
cmd.render: Render every slide of a project file to a standalone SVG
cmd.contactSheet: Render every slide of a project file into one SVG contact sheet
cmd.export: Write a project file as an editable PresentationML package or a static PDF
cmd.edit: Apply one atomic JSON edit script to a project file
cmd.slide: Print one slide and its elements from a project file
cmd.search: Search visible text across every slide of a project file
cmd.outline: Print the slide outline of a project file without rendering
cmd.assets: List the embedded assets of a project file
cmd.undo: Restore the previous committed revision of a project file
cmd.redo: Reapply the last undone revision of a project file
cmd.gui: Open the VMZ editor window on the native deck

opt.importOut: Native project file to write after import
opt.title: Deck title
opt.theme: Theme name or id applied to the new deck
opt.slide: Add a slide with this title (repeatable)
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.svg: Directory to write one SVG frame per slide
opt.outDir: Directory to write one SVG per slide
opt.exportFormat: Export format: pptx, ppsx, potx or pdf
opt.exportOut: PresentationML package or PDF to write
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: overflow, contrast, alignment, assets, fonts, out-of-bounds
opt.outlinePoints: Include body text lines as talking points per slide
opt.ops: Operations array or full edit request as inline JSON
opt.editScript: JSON file holding an operations array or a full edit request
opt.expectedRevision: Reject the edit unless the deck is at this committed revision
opt.contactSheetOut: SVG file to write the contact sheet to
opt.caseSensitive: Match text with exact letter case
opt.regex: Treat the query as a regular expression instead of literal text
opt.limit: Maximum number of matches to report (positive integer, default 100)
